item.title: From React to Remote Code – Protecting Against the Critical React2Shell RCE, Exposure
item.description:
Author: SentinelOne Research Team
Date: N/A
Tags: ["Cybersecurity", "Vulnerability Management", "Remote Code Execution", "Apache Log4j", "Threat Intelligence"]
Summary:
  • A critical RCE vulnerability named React2Shell affects Apache Log4j2.
  • Attackers can execute arbitrary code via crafted inputs.
  • The flaw arises from improper input sanitization.
  • SentinelOne urges immediate patching and asset identification.
  • Network protections and monitoring are also recommended.
  • SentinelOne offers detection tools and ongoing threat updates.

item.title: LLM as a Judge: Using LLMs to Secure Other LLMs
item.description:
Author: Ophir Dror
Date: December 07, 2025
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence Security", "Large Language Models", "Cybersecurity", "Enterprise Technology", "AI Risk Management"]
Summary:
  • LLMs pose new security risks that traditional tools struggle to prevent.
  • Attackers can exploit LLMs to leak sensitive data or bypass safety rules.
  • Existing tools miss AI-native threats like prompt injection and semantic leaks.
  • LLM-as-a-Judge uses one model to monitor and control another.
  • This method offers dynamic, context-aware security enforcement.
  • The article explores implementation, challenges, and future prospects of LLM security.
